name: Soft skills
description: Lavoro di squadra, scadenze, priorità: le parole del colloquio.

terms.definition: Working well together with other people.
terms.example: Teamwork was the key to finishing on time.

terms.definition: The date by which something must be finished.
terms.example: We met the deadline for the customer samples.

terms.definition: A balance between two good things you cannot have at the same time.
terms.example: There is a trade-off between speed and power consumption.

terms.definition: Taking full responsibility for a task until it is done.
terms.example: I took ownership of the USB validation.

terms.definition: Finding and fixing the cause of a problem step by step.
terms.example: Troubleshooting is the part of the job I enjoy most.

terms.definition: Sharing information clearly with others.
terms.example: Good communication with the design team saves a lot of time.

terms.definition: Something more important that must be done first.
terms.example: My first priority was to unblock the customer.

terms.definition: Comments about how something was done, to improve it.
terms.example: My manager gave me positive feedback on the report.

terms.definition: A person or group interested in the result of a project.
terms.example: I presented the status to all the stakeholders.

terms.definition: An important point in a project's schedule.
terms.example: The first milestone is the silicon bring-up.

terms.definition: The plan of when each task will happen.
terms.example: We are two weeks behind schedule.

terms.definition: Something you must hand over, like a report or a tool.
terms.example: The main deliverable is the characterization report.

terms.definition: The ability to find solutions to difficult problems.
terms.example: This job needs strong problem solving skills.

terms.definition: Being careful about small things.
terms.example: Attention to detail is essential in validation.

terms.definition: Helping a less experienced colleague to grow.
terms.example: I enjoy mentoring junior engineers.

terms.definition: Doing useful things without waiting to be asked.
terms.example: I took the initiative to automate the setup.

terms.definition: Being able to change your plans when the situation changes.
terms.example: Adaptability is important when the silicon arrives late.

terms.definition: Working together on a common goal.
terms.example: The collaboration with the firmware team was excellent.

terms.definition: Organizing your time to finish the most important things.
terms.example: Time management is hard when you support three projects.

terms.definition: A talk to show information to a group.
terms.example: I gave a presentation on the test results.

terms.definition: When people get together to discuss something.
terms.example: We have a short meeting every morning.

terms.definition: An action or message after something, to continue it.
terms.example: I sent a follow-up email after the call.

terms.definition: Bringing a problem to a higher level of management.
terms.example: The escalation helped us get more samples.

terms.definition: Something you understood from an experience, to do better next time.
terms.example: The main lesson learned was to automate early.

terms.definition: Making processes better step by step, all the time.
terms.example: We believe in continuous improvement of our test flow.

terms.definition: Being responsible for the results of your work.
terms.example: Accountability means you own the result, good or bad.

terms.definition: The person or company that buys the product.
terms.example: The customer reported a problem in the field.

terms.definition: Working from home or from another place, not the office.
terms.example: We do remote work two days a week.

terms.definition: Guiding and motivating a team.
terms.example: I showed leadership during the bring-up.

terms.definition: Something you want to achieve.
terms.example: Our goal is zero escapes to the customer.

terms.definition: The amount of work a person has to do.
terms.example: The workload is high before the tape-out.

terms.definition: Progressing as planned.
terms.example: The project is on track for the March release.
